note: Corpus callosum abnormalities (70%) and anterior commissure hypoplasia/agenesis (66%) are established high-frequency neuroimaging features of bi-allelic ACBD6 deficiency.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 45 individuals with bi-allelic pathogenic ACBD6 variants, midline brain malformations were frequent, specifically including corpus callosum abnormalities in 70% and hypoplasia or agenesis of the anterior commissure in 66%.

source.title: Bi-allelic ACBD6 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with progressive and complex movement disorders
source.quote: Midline brain malformations including corpus callosum abnormalities (70%), hypoplasia/agenesis of the anterior commissure (66%), short midbrain and small inferior cerebellar vermis (38% each) as well as hypertrophy of the clava (24%) were common neuroimaging findings.
